The '''High Board Room''', also known as the '''Rep Council Board Room''', or the '''Gungan Council Chamber of Judgment''', was a prestigious bubble-chamber in [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], from which the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]] ruled the city. It was referred to as the "Grandee-Oola" in [[Old Gungan/Legends|Old Gungan]].

[[File:ITW1_Rep_Council.jpg|thumb|left|200px|High Tower Boardroom cutaway]]

During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were escorted to the High Tower Boardroom to explain their presence in Otoh Gunga. [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] refused to aid the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in their plight to rescue [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], though Jinn used a [[Mind trick/Legends|Jedi mind trick]] to secure a [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|transport]] to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. He also engineered the release of [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], who was being held under arrest in the Boardroom, awaiting a severe punishment for breaking his [[Nocombackie law/Legends|banishment]].<ref name="SWE1" />

During the [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|Naboo Swamp Battle]], the High Tower Boardroom was attacked by forces led by [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]].<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The High Tower Boardroom first appeared in [[1999]] with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and its tie-ins. In the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', the High Tower Boardroom was destroyed during a mission in the Trade Federation campaign. This is a function of [[Canon#Canon and games|game mechanics]] and is contradicted by other sources, which show the Boardroom to be intact after the Swamp Battle.
